## ExtraHeaders {#Sisk_Core_Http_HttpContext_ExtraHeaders}

Gets or sets the [HttpHeaderCollection](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Entity.HttpHeaderCollection.md) indicating HTTP headers which will
be added (not overwritten) in the final response.

```csharp
public HttpHeaderCollection ExtraHeaders { get; set; }
```
